act_title: The Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934
title: Returns
text:
53. Returns.—(1) The Bank shall prepare and transmit to the [Central Government] a weekly

account of the Issue Department and of the Banking Department in [such] form as the [Central
Government] may, by notification in the Gazette of India, prescribe. The [Central Government] shall
cause these accounts to be [published in the Gazette of India at such intervals and in such modified form
as it may deem fit].
